    Is Alice Huang a spy or not?

    📅 26 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 5 min read (926 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: TechCrunch

    ⏱️ ~5 mins left to finish
    📖 0% read
    💡 Key Takeaways
    • The central, still-unproven claim in the Nvidia scandal is that Alice Huang, a former executive at the data-center firm Megaspeed, is a Chinese spy.
    • What’s publicly known is murkier than the headlines suggest.
    • Undisputed reporting shows the claim emerged from the White House itself.
    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    The central, still-unproven claim in the Nvidia scandal is that Alice Huang, a former executive at the data-center firm Megaspeed, is a Chinese spy. She had an affair with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who abruptly resigned on Nov. 12 after acknowledging it and was just as abruptly reinstated on Monday of this week.

    What’s publicly known is murkier than the headlines suggest. U.S. intelligence has reportedly tracked Alice Huang’s contact with an officer of China’s spy agency, but officials haven’t offered public evidence that she was commissioned to target Nvidia’s chief. In the past week, after President Trump successfully pushed to bring Jensen Huang back, the administration has played down the allegations it once circulated internally. Whether that reflects new intelligence or political pressure is the big question.

    Undisputed reporting shows the claim emerged from the White House itself. It first appeared in a highly classified memo written in March under the oversight of Secretary of State Marco Rubio and circulated to White House officials ahead of Trump’s trip to China in May. The memo formed the partial basis for the Upcoming York Times’ initial reporting on the scandal, published Oct. 29 and its existence was first reported on Nov. 8.

    Industry observers note that the memo did not definitively say, according to the Wall Street Journal, that Alice Huang was a Chinese spy. CNN, by contrast, has reported that the memo concluded she was a Chinese intelligence asset.

    What’s better established is that Alice Huang was in touch with Chinese intelligence. The Ministry of State Security (MSS) is Beijing’s civilian spy agency, responsible for both foreign intelligence and domestic counterintelligence. Last weekend, the Times, citing people with knowledge of U.S. intelligence reports, reported that Huang was in contact with an MSS officer from the spring of 2025 until this fall, a period that overlaps her relationship with Jensen Huang. (The Chinese government has called the spy claims a “smear,” and Megaspeed notes Huang left the firm in August 2025 and that its business is legitimate.).

    Attorney General Todd Blanche, who was Trump’s personal defense lawyer before taking over the Justice Department, told journalists on Tuesday: “I have no reason to stand up here and say Nvidia is anything but a good corporate citizen.” On the same day, Trump remarked a pardon was an option for Jensen Huang but that he did not think one would be needed. Senior intelligence officials reportedly told Congress that the government apparently has no actual evidence that the MSS directed Alice Huang to pursue an affair with Jensen Huang.

    None of those statements necessarily exonerates Alice Huang as an intelligence agent. Instead, they support the alternate theory that the Chinese government didn’t tell her to begin the affair and that Jensen Huang broke no law by having it.

    Recent findings suggest that from a certain angle, the circumstantial evidence surrounding Alice Huang looks quite suspicious. She was a top executive at a company investigated for illicitly channeling Nvidia chips to China, and her husband, Kang Wei, is said to have even closer ties to the MSS, with some sources saying he worked for the agency.

    Sources indicate that the timing of the government’s reversal is at the heart of the matter. Trump has said he lobbied the board “directly and indirectly” to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, so it wouldn’t be surprising if officials who serve at his pleasure were recasting the case in terms that satisfy his agenda. That wouldn’t necessarily make their assessments wrong. But unless newly introduced intelligence has actually resolved the question, and none has been publicly identified as yet, that backdrop is critical to keep in mind. CBS has also reported that Rubio has privately voiced concerns about aspects of Jensen Huang’s return.

    Earlier this month, CNN reported that the intelligence community was still working to understand Alice Huang’s relationship with Jensen Huang and that the intelligence collected on her to date does not prove she was acting as a spy for Beijing. After a briefing by top intelligence officials earlier this month, Rep. Jim Himes (D-Conn.), the incoming chair of the House Intelligence Committee, noted he was unsure whether she was a spy or a “useful idiot.” And this week, the Wall Street Journal pointed out that under Chinese leader Xi Jinping, top corporate executives routinely maintain ties to the country’s intelligence service without being formally deputized as assets.

    Industry observers note that the crush of conflicting claims, most from anonymous government sources, obviously leaves large questions unanswered as to what actually transpired. Some of those questions that naturally spring to mind:.

    There are answers to all of these questions, of course, but when the public will get them is anybody’s guess. Jensen Huang is due to appear before the Senate Banking Committee next week, and by the look from the statements of some of its members, he’s likely in for a rough ride. Unfortunately, congressional hearings, particularly public ones, rarely unearth secrets that haven’t already been disclosed.

    📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

    MPC Sample 1.4 officially opens up the device to modders and third-party developers.

    MPC Sample 1.4 officially opens up the device to modders and third-party developers.

    According to recent reports, akai is continuing to open up its various music-making platforms with the MPC Sample 1.4 firmware. My favorite (and the most affordable) of the MPC samplers has become a popular home for vibe-coded custom firmwares and mods. The company has decided, rather than fight it, to embrace the modding community. The latest update adds several new developer features, including support for the new SDK and custom Knob Effects plugins.

    Sources indicate that plugins added to the appropriate folder on your microSD card are now automatically recognized and will appear at the bottom of the list in the Knob Effects menu. There’s also a Developer Mode, which lets you run scripts from the microSD card or access the sampler’s internal filesystem over USB, which will be handy for all those modders vibe-coding their own add-ons for the MPC. There’s also remote screen access for mirroring the display on an external monitor through the MPC Remote Screen Viewer app.

    In a recent development, there are a few other nice updates, including flatten pad, which speeds up the resampling process for baking in effects on individual pads, and sequence record autoplay, which adds a looper-like experience. Akai also added a scale option to the 16-levels pad mode, so you’re not limited to 16 chromatic notes, and can instead play melodic one-shots in E minor pentatonic, B major, or whatever key your track happens to be in.

    For a look at some of the custom firmwares, effects, and other mods already available for the MPC Sample, check out this video from Loopop.

    What started as one artist’s response to being cut out of a music video has exploded, becoming a driving force in Nigeria’s cultural landscape.

    As a student in the central Nigerian city of Ilorin, Lawal Habeeb Kola loved staying in his hostel room to produce beats rather than returning to his family house in Lagos, the more frenetic city of his birth.

    Industry observers note that in 2022, one of his beats became popular on TikTok, and a version featuring ad-libbed vocals from a hypeman sent it viral. He was invited to the music video shoot in Lagos and thought his big break had finally come, but when the video was released, he was absent.
